let gates : List (Bool × Nat × Nat) := [(false,0,1), (false,3,9), (true,15,27), (true,17,26), (true,13,26), (true,13,27), (false,2,6), (true,1,24), (true,15,32), (true,25,32), (true,0,17), (true,0,23), (true,0,25), (false,17,19), (false,20,24), (false,39,40), (true,7,41)]
let wires := gates.foldl (fun (w : List Nat) g =>
  let a := w.getD g.2.1 0
  let b := w.getD g.2.2 0
  w ++ [if g.1 then a &&& b else a ||| b]) raw
let guard := wires.getD 32 0
let initial := wires ++ wires.map (fun x => x &&& guard)
let side := fun (w is : List Nat) => is.foldl (fun v i => v ||| w.getD i 0) 0
∃ ops : List (List Nat × List Nat), ops.length = 6 ∧
  (∀ i : Fin ops.length, ∀ j ∈ ((ops.get i).1 ++ (ops.get i).2), j < 86 + 2 * i.val) ∧
  let pool := ops.foldl (fun w g =>
    let v := side w g.1 &&& side w g.2
    w ++ [v, v &&& guard]) initial
  pool.getD 96 0 = 1391901293487636715004617847713145431845373679996436155248510458865419897745065855990250003206757279244673510251236404773163809179607118503720312974657470768
